game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Island Ferry, the island ferry landing: the sailor must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Island Ferry: the island ferry landing
core_gameplay_loop: In Island Ferry, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, a new anchors challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 340 points of anchors by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Island Ferry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Island Ferry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 34 seconds.
